name: io.github.tonyyang0504/whatsapp-mcp
description: WhatsApp Business (messaging): me, send, mark_read. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: System user access token or business token of the WhatsApp Business Account (whatsapp_business_messaging, whatsapp_business_management), sent as `Authorization: Bearer` as in every Cloud API example (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/messages/text-messages).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
environmentVariables.description: WhatsApp business phone number ID (not the phone number itself, e.g. 106540352242922; GET /<WABA_ID>/phone_numbers lists them). Every call goes to /<phone_number_id>/... Env: PLATFORM_MCP_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.
